news.title: Global Market: Foreign investors pull $23.5 billion from Asian equities in September as US yields surge
news.description: Foreign investors withdrew $23.49 billion from Asian equities in September as rising US Treasury yields, inflation fears and tighter monetary policies weakened risk appetite. South Korea and India led outflows, while hedge funds reduced exposure amid persistent market uncertainty.
